title: Following reopen's hint for a gone touch leaves the item able to pass done
goal: After backlog.py reopen on a done item whose touches name a file a later commit deleted, doing what reopen prints and then repointing the check lets done exit 0: today the hint says repoint them with set ID --touch PATH, and dropping the gone path makes done refuse the item's own work commit that changed it as outside touches. Either the hint (and kb/_self/backlog.md, kb/_self/tools.md) says to keep a touch the item's own work commits changed and repoint only the checks, or done's scope rule accepts an item's commits touching a path that is gone from the tree and was in its touches when it was done; gate g1 picks one before any code. Planted check: a done story whose work commit changed src/old_test.py, deleted by a later commit; reopen, follow the printed set --touch hint literally (PATH replaced by the touches that still exist), set --check, then done must exit 0. From the SP-hyp6o7hl retrospective.

run:
import json,os,shlex,shutil,subprocess as sp,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
S=Path.cwd();t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());d=t/'r';c=1
try:
    b=d/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';b.mkdir(parents=True);(d/'src').mkdir()
    g=lambda *a:sp.run(['git','-C',str(d),'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@example.com',*a],capture_output=True,check=True)
    W=lambda p,s:Path(d/p).write_text(s)
    B=lambda *a:sp.run([sys.executable,str(S/'_tools'/'backlog.py'),'--root',str(d),*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
    g('init','-q','-b','main');W('src/old_test.py','x=1\n');W('src/x.py','print(1)\n');g('add','-A');g('commit','-qm','base')
    W('src/old_test.py','x=2\n');W('src/x.py','print(2)\n');g('commit','-qam','work\n\nKB-Work: ST-aaaaaaaa')
    g('rm','-q','src/old_test.py');g('commit','-qm','move tests\n\nKB-Work: ST-bbbbbbbb');g('update-ref','refs/remotes/origin/main','HEAD')
    T=['src/x.py','src/old_test.py']
    W('kb/_self/backlog/ST-aaaaaaaa.json',json.dumps({'id':'ST-aaaaaaaa','kind':'story','title':'T','status':'done','priority':'P3','rank':0,'goal':'g','checks':[{'run':['python3','src/old_test.py']}],'touches':T,'evidence':{'commit':'0'*40,'checks':[]}}))
    r=B('reopen','ST-aaaaaaaa','--why','its check names a deleted test');o=r.stdout+r.stderr;print(o.strip())
    gone=[p for p in T if 'names '+p in o]
    hint=[ln.split('backlog.py',1)[1] for ln in o.splitlines() if 'backlog.py set' in ln and '--touch' in ln]
    for h in hint[:1]:
        a=shlex.split(h);k=a.index('PATH') if 'PATH' in a else None
        if k is not None:a=a[:k]+[x for x in T if x not in gone][:1]+[y for p in [x for x in T if x not in gone][1:] for y in ('--touch',p)]+[x for x in a[k+1:] if x!='...']
        print('follow:',a);s=B(*a);print(s.stdout+s.stderr)
    s=B('set','ST-aaaaaaaa','--check','python3 src/x.py');print(s.stdout+s.stderr)
    r2=B('done','ST-aaaaaaaa');print('done exit',r2.returncode,(r2.stdout+r2.stderr).strip()[-400:])
    R=[r.returncode==0,bool(gone),r2.returncode==0];print(R);c=0 if all(R) else 1
except Exception as x:print('check error',type(x).__name__,str(x)[:200])
finally:shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(c)

gates.question: After reopen reveals a gone touch that the item's own work commit changed, what makes done pass: the reopen hint (and kb/_self/backlog.md, tools.md) says to keep that touch and repoint only the checks, or done's scope rule accepts the item's commits touching a path gone from the tree that was in its touches when it was done?

notes: Premise: the item's check shows done refusing after the hint is followed ('commit ... changed src/old_test.py, outside touches', exit 1, [True, True, False]) on 2026-10-06; with the gone touch kept and only the check repointed the same planted repo passes done (exit 0). In SP-hyp6o7hl, after BG-c4cjoyyi, following the hint made done refuse 'commit <work commit> changed _tools/test_bl_items.py, outside touches'. The hint is bl_items.cmd_reopen; the refusal is bl_land.out_of_scope in cmd_done. ST-zzsbdbi7 plans a runbook sentence that a gone path is removed by re-setting the touch list: whichever answer g1 gets, that sentence must agree with it.
